tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, everywhere.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Surfaces laid on bg: the "what depends on you" card, the message bubbles, the expanded examples, the footer of the mails.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules and separators that carry no meaning: under the header, between the rows of a list.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Outline of the fields and of the choice cards at rest. In light, 1.7:1 on bg, under the 3:1 threshold of a control outline: taken as is from the mockups, to be reviewed (a gray #8A8A8A would pass).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg and surface; 2 px rules of a list heading; outline of the secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, help, metadata, on bg and surface (at least 5.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: delft
tokens.usage: Act, choose, move forward: primary button, selected choice (2 px border), completed progress segments, completed steps, data bars, underline of the current page's link. As text, on bg and surface (7.7:1 in light).

tokens.name: delft-deep
tokens.usage: The primary button, hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: delft-pale
tokens.usage: Track of the data bars (the part that remains) and tinted background behind a blue element. Never text.

tokens.name: on-delft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a delft fill (the label of the primary button).

tokens.name: vermillion
tokens.usage: Attention, rarely: the mono kickers, the current step (a small diamond), what awaits a review, the top rule of the "what depends on you" card, the operator's hot figures, the icon of an error and the top rule of a form alert. One or two touches per screen, plus the tulip. Never a button. As text: on bg only (4.6:1 in light); on surface it drops to 4.2:1, so no vermillion text on surface under 24 px.

tokens.name: on-vermillion
tokens.usage: Text on a vermillion fill: the numbered dots of the remarks placed on an image.

tokens.name: tulip-flower
tokens.usage: The flower of the tulip, in the logo only.

tokens.name: tulip-stem
tokens.usage: The stem and the leaf of the tulip, in the logo only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2 px solid, offset by 2 px (7.7:1 on bg in light, 7.2:1 in dark).

groups.name: Logo
groups.note: Newsreader 500, for the name in the logo and nothing else.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the tulip; its size follows the lockup's.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Inter Tight 700, tightened. A sentence that says what is happening.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: The heading of a key moment, on a computer.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: The heading of a page of the client space or of the operator's home.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: A question of the brief or of the questionnaire, on a computer.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Headings on a phone; the heading of an action card.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter. 720 px wide at most, for reading.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The sentence under a heading, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: I have a site to modernize
styles.usage: The label of a choice card, of a primary button.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No worries if the holidays take up all your time.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: For example: it is ten years old, it is slow, it looks dated.
styles.usage: The examples under a choice, the navigation.

groups.name: Markers
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono, small, to situate.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Above a heading, in vermillion on bg.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Relative dates, counters, figures in columns (tabular-nums).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between two progress segments; between a label and its help line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The base step. Between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between two choice cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side margin on a phone; between two paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inside a card on a phone; between two buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inside an action card; side margin on a computer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between two sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a page and wide breathing room on a computer.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between the main column and the column of the exchanges.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, fields, images, fills.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The tile of the icon only (6 out of 32).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The avatars and the numbered dots, nothing else.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any target: links, fields, tabs.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of the primary button and of the brief's fields.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a reading column.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a short form's fields and buttons on a computer: the sign-in, a new password. The heading and the lead above it keep the reading column.

tokens.name: mail-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a mail.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, field outlines, secondary button.

tokens.name: border-select
tokens.usage: The selected choice (in delft); the heading rule of a list (in ink).

tokens.name: border-attention
tokens.usage: The top rule, in vermillion, of the "what depends on you" card and of a form alert.
